outcome: Maternal physical health-related quality of life (HRQoL)
Maternal emotional health-related quality of life (HRQoL)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 3614 mothers of preterm children born before 35 weeks' gestation in France, drawn from the EPIPAGE-2 nationwide population-based cohort.
finding: Social disadvantage during pregnancy was identified as a significant risk factor for poor maternal physical health-related quality of life at 1 year after a preterm birth, while no clear association was found with mental HRQoL.
